summary: Frontend testing complete for Job Posting Quality Gate feature. All 17 features verified working correctly. The quality gate enforces 9 required fields (title, specialty, location, description 20+ chars, shift_type, pay >$0, job_type, experience, start_date). Travel/Contract jobs add 2 more required fields (duration, stipend). Publish button disabled until all fields complete. Autocomplete components working for Specialty, Location, and Certifications.
passed_tests: New job form shows '9 required fields remaining' when empty
Publish Job button is disabled when required fields are missing
Specialty field uses SpecialtyAutocomplete (searchable, shows suggestions like 'ICU/Critical Care (RN)')
Location field uses LocationAutocomplete (searchable, shows suggestions like 'Los Angeles, CA')
Certifications field uses InlineAutocomplete with suggestions (BLS, ACLS, etc.)
Job Type dropdown shows 5 options: Travel Contract, Per Diem, Staff/Permanent, PRN, Local Contract
Selecting 'Travel Contract' as job type makes Duration and Stipend required (10 fields total)
Pay must be > $0 — shows amber warning 'Compensation is required — jobs without pay are skipped by seekers'
Experience Required is required (accepts 0 explicitly - shows '0+ years' in review)
Progress tracker shows ⚠️ warning icons on sections with missing required fields (Schedule, Compensation)
Review section shows missing fields as amber badges (title, specialty, location, etc.)
Review section shows 'Ready to publish — all required fields are complete' when all fields are complete
Filling all required fields enables the Publish button
Weak title auto-generates seeker-facing title from specialty+shift (e.g., 'Med-Surg RN – Night Shift')
Description requires minimum 20 characters - shows 'Please write at least 20 characters' warning
Submitting a complete job works correctly - redirects to poster dashboard with success toast
critical_code_review_comments: requiredFields object correctly tracks all 9 base required fields plus travel-specific fields
sectionErrors Set correctly identifies sections with missing required fields
generateTitle() function correctly creates seeker-facing title from specialty+shift
isWeakTitle() regex correctly identifies weak titles: /test|posting|job\s*\d|^\d+$/i or length < 5
isTravelContract correctly triggers for 'Travel Contract' or 'Local Contract' job types
SpecialtyAutocomplete, LocationAutocomplete, InlineAutocomplete components working correctly
Auto-save only triggers in edit mode (isEdit check)
Form validation prevents submission until all required fields are complete
